failure_summary.description: The answer was related but did not match the expected lexical form, such as an unexpanded initialism, an unnecessary name component, or an expanded title.
The response missed the requested relation or attribute, choosing a description, work category, formal name, or value dimension instead.

patch.reasoning: The skill already instructs agents to identify the requested relation and answer at the requested specificity, so the relation errors do not warrant duplicating that guidance. Add only two targeted checks for gaps visible in the batch: expand an initialism when the clue asks what feature it denotes, and preserve the exact dimension named in a comparison.

edits.content: When a clue uses an initialism as shorthand for a feature and asks what the feature is, give the expanded canonical term rather than repeating the initialism. If the clue instead asks for the abbreviation, return the initialism.
For comparisons and superlatives, preserve the stated dimension: for example, physical size is not the same as value or denomination. Compare candidates only on the attribute the clue names.
